additional_info.subject: 0426091 - ID0426091-DC/Si-D/TH-[MP/R3 170001691] Screen is blank CRM:00798002214
additional_info.body:
Hi Edna,
Thanks for the Quick call.
As discussed, We can consider replacing the HMI provided troubleshooting is performed as per following.
We need to troubleshoot all the components.
Also, As discussed, We always recommend using Siemens Approved Parts only, dont go with 3rd Party DP cable.
We need to check the FC14, Also we need to have spare while site intervention.
We need to check for the 24v and 0v on HMI.
Also, Ensure HDMI and USB cable are also not having issues. You can check by replacing with new one.
If 24v is absent,
We need to check for the following Highlighted Terminals.
Also, We need to check if the blackscreen is due to any of the following Qfeedback is applicable.
http://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/ww/en/view/109816643
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/ww/en/view/109816666
Do let us know if you additional information.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
